engine.notes: Bakersfield has had improv since 1989 (a ComedySportz franchise, the Center for Improv Advancement, The Revengers) but in 2026 the scene is a monthly drop-in and Brian's Beard, a troupe that announces first-Saturday shows on Instagram only. The Well Comedy Club is stand-up and the Gaslight Melodrama stages scripted melodrama, so neither is listed.
